E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres). All five slots modeled with sourced numbers.

step_1_pin_AP_from_the_old_value.why: The 60-splinter bonus is TRUE damage, so it is mitigation-independent (S5). It therefore pins total AP with no knowledge of the target's MR.
step_1_pin_AP_from_the_old_value.formula_from_S2_plain_text: true = (0.12 + 0.02 * AP/100) * (190 + 0.65 * AP)   [12% + 2% per 100 AP of the Force of Will magic damage]
step_1_pin_AP_from_the_old_value.expanded: true(AP) = 22.8 + 0.116*AP + 0.00013*AP^2   -- first two coefficients reproduce the wiki 'Bonus True Damage' rank-5 row (22.8, 11.6% AP) exactly
step_1_pin_AP_from_the_old_value.cross_check_with_S3: 690 = 600 * 1.15, i.e. 600 base AP amplified by the 120-Splinter Transcendence buff -- consistent with the scenario name '..._120'.

step_2_compute_the_magic_row_at_that_AP.mitigation: post = raw * 100/(100+R_eff) (S5). Observed new value 638.5 == raw, so R_eff = 0 for this manual target (a 0-MR verification dummy, or 30 MR fully erased by 40% + 18 flat magic pen: max(0, 30*0.6 - 18) = 0).

step_4_independent_closure_on_the_wiki_t.conclusion: 638.5 and 164.7 are the two components of ONE Force of Will hit at 690 total AP: 638.5 is the base magic damage, 164.7 is the 60-Splinter bonus true damage, which is 25.8% OF the 638.5. They are not competing values for the same quantity.

step_5_which_belongs_at_damage_events[8].argument_1: 638.5 is the ability's primary, sourced magic-damage row (S1). A damage ledger for a Force of Will recast must contain it; a ledger that reports only 164.7 for the hit prices the derived bonus and drops the base instance (a ~4x understatement of the W hit: 164.7 vs 803.2 total).
step_5_which_belongs_at_damage_events[8].argument_2: The true damage is defined AS a fraction of the magic damage dealt (S2). The derived component cannot precede the instance it is derived from, so the magic event must occupy the earlier index of the pair.
step_5_which_belongs_at_damage_events[8].argument_3: Both values are exactly sourced numbers at the same AP, so this is a structural (event emission / ordering) correction, not a stat or formula regression: no stat had to change for 164.7 -> 638.5, and 638.5 is not a mis-computation of anything -- it is 190 + 65% AP to the 0.1.
step_5_which_belongs_at_damage_events[8].residual_uncertainty: The golden scenario definition (level, ranks, items, target resistances, cast order) lives under scripts/ and tests/, which this runbook forbids reading, so the index-8 slot could in principle also have shifted because a spurious earlier event was removed (e.g. the wiki note 'The initial cast does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade'). Every such reading still places the magic row, 638.5, at the fixed index; none makes 164.7 the value a correct ledger reports there while the magic instance is absent.

conclusion: At 690 total AP (600 x 1.15 Transcendence at 120 Splinters) and 0 effective MR, Force of Will rank 5 deals 638.5 magic damage plus 164.7 bonus true damage, totalling 803.2 -- which reproduces the wiki's own 'Total Mixed Damage' row exactly. The new leaf value 638.5 is the correctly-sourced magic-damage event; the old value 164.7 is the derived 25.8% true-damage bonus standing where the base instance belongs.
